title: Warm and Wok-Seared Middle-Eastern Chinese Long Beans Pilaf
description: A hearty, earthy pilaf made with Chinese long beans, served with a side of warm beurre-monte sauce.
instructions: Heat a salt block in the oven to 375°F (190°C) for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the Chinese long beans and cook until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and serve with a side of warm beurre-monte sauce.
To make the beurre-monte sauce, mix together 1/4 cup of ghee or vegetable oil and 2 tablespoons of lemon juice in a small bowl.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the sauce on the side of the pilaf.
